answers: Not really. Branches are just pointers to shared Git objects, so deleting them usually frees very little space.
The uploads/tmp directory is the main target, since reclaiming all 31 GB could bring disk usage to roughly 79%.

Server address, approved SSH access method, temp-file rules (users, retention, in-use checks, whether uploads/jobs can pause), branch rules (release branch, protected names), and recovery requirements.
